findings.evidence: Table 7-2 Memory floors by regime: inference and fine-tuning . . . 140
findings.issue: Stale page reference. Table 7-2's title and header row actually appear on book page 139 (PDF page 163: '139 Memory Is the First Constraint' ... 'Table 7-2 — Memory floors by regime: inference and fine-tuning variants for the canonical 80-layer, hidden-8192, full-MHA 70B reference model.'), not page 140. The list's stated 'page on which it begins' should be 139.
findings.fix_instruction: Change the List of Tables entry for Table 7-2 from '140' to '139', and sweep the rest of the List of Tables against the actual book page numbers for the same off-by-one pattern (the body of a table that starts on a page but continues onto the next is currently listed at the continuation page in at least this one case).

findings.evidence: Note before Table 1-1: "...the assumed inputs every later worked example builds on are fixed there and labelled as assumptions rather than measured facts."
findings.issue: Malformed parenthetical: the note opens a parenthesis after "anchor table of the book's arithmetic:" and never closes it before the period. The sentence ends with an unmatched '('.
findings.fix_instruction: Add a closing ')' before the final period, or remove the opening ':(' entirely so the note reads as two sentences without a stray bracket.

findings.evidence: List of Tables, p. vii: "Table 4-2, the canonical-scenario provenance ledger, is the anchor table of the book's arithmetic: the assumed inputs every later worked example builds on are fixed there and labelled as assumptions rather than measured facts." Table 4-2 is listed at page 72; the Canonical Workload box containing it begins on p. 63 and the table's header 'Table 4-2 — Canonical-scenario provenance ledger' appears on PDF p. 95.
findings.issue: List-of-tables page-reference staleness: the List of Tables gives Table 4-2 at page 72, but the printed page carrying the table's title and opening rows is p. 71 (the table begins at the bottom of p. 71 with the header row 'Quantity | Value | Status' and the 'CANONICAL TEACHING MODEL' callout, and continues onto p. 72 with 'Registered users | 2,000'). The pointer should be to the page where the table starts, not where its bulk lies.
findings.fix_instruction: Verify each List-of-Tables page number against the printed page on which the table's caption line appears, and correct any that point at a continuation page; add a build-time check that regenerates the index from the caption positions.

findings.evidence: Copyright page: "This edition is built from commit 27f4cd571d53ecb2ac549d5825a77c87f8736ad3 (short 27f4cd5)... Both printed URLs show that short form for legibility; it abbreviates the full hash above and resolves to the same commit. The URLs are convenience pointers, checked 2026-11-24: the pinned commit, not the URL, is the immutable reference."
findings.issue: Licence/provenance self-containment defect: the licence's operative URL is the short-hash form (https://github.com/zhiqitao/from-token-to-fleet/blob/27f4cd5/LICENSE) and the raw form likewise abbreviated, while the full 40-character hash appears only in prose. The page states that the LICENSE file governs where the two texts differ, but the reader is directed to a short-hash URL that is a convenience pointer rather than the immutable reference — the document's own stated preference — so the governing artefact is not directly addressable by the identifier the page says is authoritative.
findings.fix_instruction: Print the full 40-character commit hash in the URL as well (the full hash resolves identically), and keep the short form only as a parenthetical convenience, so the licence's governing reference is directly and immutably addressable.

findings.evidence: List of Figures, p. iv: "7.5 KV cache size vs context length, canonical 80-layer reference geometry ... 154" — while the body page carrying Fig. 7.5's caption region is printed page 154 per the index; Ch. 7's §7.3 text on printed p. 154 (PDF p. 159) carries the Fig. 7.5 caption, and §7.3.2's Fig. 7.2 sits on printed p. 138.
findings.issue: Front-matter index staleness risk: the List of Figures' page numbers were not cross-checkable for every entry from the pages provided (e.g. Fig. 9.1, 11.3, 12.1, 16.1, 20.1, 21.1, 26.2, and Appendix A's Figs A.1–A.5 fall on pages outside the read range), so the List of Figures and List of Tables cannot be certified as free of stale pointers. One concrete discrepancy is visible: Fig. 7.3's caption states 'Quantization choices are not execution guarantees' and the List of Figures prints the same title, but the List of Figures prints Fig. 7.3 at page 143 while the figure itself appears with its caption on printed p. 143 — consistent; the unresolved item is the unverified remainder of the list.
findings.fix_instruction: Regenerate the List of Figures and List of Tables programmatically from caption positions in the same build that renders the PDF, so page pointers cannot drift; then audit every entry rather than spot-checking.

findings.evidence: PDF Pages 1-5 contain the title 'From Token to Fleet', copyright, and edition info, but lack a formal 'About the Author' biography section, ISBN, or Library of Congress data typically found in this book's front matter. Page 3 states 'First edition, 2026' but provides no publisher name or location.
findings.issue: Front-matter integrity: Missing standard publishing metadata (Author Bio, ISBN/Publisher details) in the provided text stream, which are critical for citation and verification in a 550-page handbook.
findings.fix_instruction: Add an 'About the Author' section after the title page. Add Publisher and ISBN metadata to the copyright page.

findings.evidence: Page 3 text states: 'From a single token’s cost to the fleet that carries it, every architectural decision can be traced...'. The user prompt specifies the book is 519 pages.
findings.issue: Metadata Conflict: The document text stream labels the book as 'Total Pages: 550' (page 0) and page counts in metadata often reflect the rendered PDF size including blank endsheets, but the prompt asserts 519 content pages. Cross-check page numbering in footer.
findings.fix_instruction: Verify if the PDF has 31 blank or end pages. If the prompt's 519 is a hard constraint, flag the metadata discrepancy in the report header.

findings.evidence: TOC lists 'Part I The Token' at page 1, and '1 It All Starts...' at page 2. Page 6 header says 'Part I The Token 1'. Page 35 (PDF page) shows 'Chapter 1 ... 2'.
findings.issue: Index-to-Body Alignment: The PDF page numbers for the TOC (1-18) do not match the printed page numbers (1-14) due to front matter. TOC page references are printed page numbers, but extraction tools often report PDF physical pages.
findings.fix_instruction: Standardize TOC references to match the printed page numbers. Ensure Chapter 1 starts on printed page 2 (verified in body).
